title: Apply for a licence to supply explosives or security sensitive dangerous substances
summary: This page provides information on applying for a licence required to supply, including exporting, explosives or security sensitive dangerous substances (SSDS).
intro:
If you want to supply (including exporting) explosives or security sensitive dangerous substances (SSDS), you need to apply for a licence.

The licence is valid for 5 years and allows you to purchase and possess the materials, and store them in the premises specified on the licence.

The licence can be issued to you or to a nominated person on behalf of a company.
who_can_apply: Hold a current NSW security clearance (SC) or provide evidence of lodging an SC application.
Have adequate arrangements in place for the safe handling and storage of explosives and/or SSDS.
Have a legitimate reason for requesting the licence.
what_you_need: Your reason(s) for requesting a licence.
Your security clearance (SC) licence details, or evidence you have lodged an SC licence application.
A statement outlining your experience and knowledge in:
Details of interstate explosives licence/s (if applicable).
Details of the explosives or SSDS to be supplied.
Details of explosives and/or SSDS to be imported and/or exported (if applicable).
Details of explosives and/or SSDS to be stored (if applicable).
Confirmation that the quantities in this application align with the security plan and emergency plan.
Emergency contact's details, and emergency plan.
Evidence for the submission of the emergency plan to Fire and Rescue NSW.
Evidence for the submission of the emergency plan to NSW Rural Fire Service (if the facility is located in a rural fire district).

how_to_steps.text: Collect all the required documentation including the material and payment needed for your SC application (if applicable).

more_info.text: The nominated person for a company must be involved in the management of the company. If that person ceases to be the nominated person, for example if they resign, the company must nominate another person to take responsibility for the licence within 7 days.
If you're lodging your application for an SC licence at the same time, it will have to be approved before your supply application will be processed.
The SC licence was previously called an unsupervised handling licence (UHL).
If you're storing hazardous chemicals you must notify SafeWork NSW.

faqs.q: How long is the licence valid for?
faqs.a: The licence is valid for 5 years.
The licence can be issued to you or to a nominated person on behalf of a company.

faqs.q: What are the steps to apply for the licence?
faqs.a: Select the 'Apply online' button, complete the form, collect all required documentation (including material and payment for SC application if applicable), and submit your application with payment.
